endpoints.desc: Retrieve the latest version of a document (full structured content)
Create a new blank document with a title
Apply a list of update Requests to an existing document (the workhorse endpoint)

design_note: batchUpdate is a single endpoint that accepts an array of typed Request objects. This maps cleanly onto the PleaseREST modular write model: each request type becomes a 'unit' component emitting one request JSON, an aggregator gathers them into a 'requests' array, and a single BatchUpdate 'write' component sends them. One payload contract (Request JSON list) feeds the one write verb.
notes: batchUpdate path uses a custom-method colon suffix ':batchUpdate' (not a standard sub-path)
No DELETE endpoints exist in the Docs API — document deletion is handled by the Drive API (out of scope for this plugin)
Discovery doc is Google's own format, not OpenAPI/Swagger; api-extractor may need extract_from_docs rather than extract_from_openapi
